title: Identification of Cellular Senescence-Related Hub Genes in Rheumatoid Arthritis from Bioinformatics Analysis Through Machine Learning up to Verifications in Mouse Macrophages and Tests in Patients.
authors: Wang, Dandan; Tian, Linkun; Ma, Qingshan; Zhang, Zhengdong; Wang, Yi; Fang, Junhao; Xu, Hairong; Chen, Qi; Chen, Hongdian; Wang, Fangyuan; Zhang, Qiaoyan; Zhang, Quanlong; Qin, Luping
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学与机器学习筛选类风湿关节炎衰老相关基因，聚焦巨噬细胞表型与临床验证，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by synovial inflammation and joint destruction. Cellular senescence contributes to chronic inflammation, yet key senescence-associated regulators in RA remain unclear. This study aimed to identify RA senescence-related signatures and their roles. Using GSE89408 as the training cohort, we screened hub genes by intersecting differentially expressed and senescence-related genes via WGCNA and three machine learning algorithms, with GSE55457 for external validation. Immune infiltration, regulatory network, subtyping and drug prediction were analyzed. Clinical and in vitro assays validated RIPK2 expression and function in the macrophage senescence-like phenotype, with preliminary signaling exploration. Three senescence-related hub genes (TNFAIP6, SLC2A3, RIPK2) were identified. The derived nomogram showed robust diagnostic performance (AUC = 0.988). Hub genes correlated strongly with myeloid cells, especially macrophages. Two immunologically distinct RA subtypes were identified. RIPK2 was upregulated in clinical samples; its inhibition attenuated LPS-induced macrophage senescence-like changes and inflammation. Preliminary data suggested RIPK2 may act via the NF-kappaB pathway. This study identifies RA senescence-associated signatures, revealing RIPK2 linking innate immunity to macrophage senescence-like changes, offering novel insights into pathogenesis and supporting it as a candidate biomarker and therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）是一种以滑膜炎症和关节破坏为特征的慢性自身免疫性疾病。细胞衰老 contributes to 慢性炎症，但RA中关键的衰老相关调控因子仍不明确。本研究旨在识别RA衰老相关特征及其作用。以GSE89408作为训练队列，通过WGCNA和三种机器学习算法，对差异表达基因与衰老相关基因取交集筛选核心基因，并以GSE55457进行外部验证。分析了免疫浸润、调控网络、亚型分型和药物预测。临床和体外实验验证了RIPK2在巨噬细胞衰老样表型中的表达和功能，并进行了初步信号通路探索。鉴定出三个衰老相关核心基因（TNFAIP6、SLC2A3、RIPK2）。所构建的列线图显示出稳健的诊断性能（AUC = 0.988）。核心基因与髓系细胞，尤其是巨噬细胞，显著相关。识别出两种免疫学上不同的RA亚型。RIPK2在临床样本中表达上调；其抑制减弱了LPS诱导的巨噬细胞衰老样变化和炎症。初步数据提示RIPK2可能通过NF-kappaB通路发挥作用。本研究识别了RA衰老相关特征，揭示RIPK2将先天免疫与巨噬细胞衰老样变化联系起来，为发病机制提供了新见解，并支持其作为候选生物标志物和治疗靶点。
